# Unlimited, sustainably.

Switch once. Keep building. 0code is sustainably unlimited and will always be free.

## Why switch to 0code?

- One request, no SDK. Call GET /api/chat/<prompt> from any language, script, or prototype. During high usage, the same request returns a queue ID while it finishes safely in the background.

- No single-provider dead end. Provider quotas, outages, and busy models are handled with automatic fallback.

- Fast by default. 0code learns which available models respond fastest and quietly prefers them.

- No lock-in. You use one stable endpoint instead of rewriting your app around each provider's API.

- Sustainable by design. 0code routes around provider limits instead of repeatedly leaning on one API, while lightweight bot protection keeps shared capacity available for real users.

- Free for everyone. 0code will always be free, without the hard request limits common elsewhere.
